programme.title: A Fire Without End
programme.desc: On November 26, 2025, Hong Kong firefighters were called to Wang Fuk Court, a complex of eight 31-story residential towers. What followed was the city’s deadliest fire in almost eight decades, an inferno that claimed 168 lives and triggered a year of recriminations over who was at fault. Bloomberg Investigates examines the ignored warnings and missed opportunities that preceded this disaster, one that continues to devastate the families of the dead and the fire's survivors to this day.

programme.desc: Using a form of integration at Indiana State that goes beyond race, the Residential Treatment Unit selects inmates with a history of good behavior to live with and serve as mentors to inmates with mental health issues.

programme.title: Lockup: Sacramento: Extended Stay
programme.desc: One inmate contends that a law could put him away forever; an inmate sentenced to life without parole prays that a new law will set him free.

programme.title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
programme.desc: A massive search for contraband throughout the facility turns up the heat on two inmates inside the Santa Rosa Correctional Institution; a convict prompts an evacuation when he floods his housing unit.

programme.title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
programme.desc: A violent gang member asks to move back to general population, following six years in segregation; a brother and sister are charged with murdering a high school football star, two years after he was stabbed to death on an Oakland street corner.

programme.title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
programme.desc: Welcome to Limon Correctional Facility, a level 4 prison that houses many of Colorado's most dangerous inmates; while visiting Limon Correctional, the Lockup crew is greeted by angry inmates and the cell extraction team is called in to help.

programme.title: Lockup Special Investigation
programme.desc: For some kids, the revolving door of lockup seems to snag one generation after the next; 17-year-old Kenneth and 14-year-old Kentrell have 10 brothers and sisters, a father in prison and a mother with a criminal record for public nuisance.

programme.title: Lockup Special Investigation
programme.desc: More than three thousand kids pass through the juvenile courts in Lake County, Indiana each year; here, consequences can range from a sleepless night in detention to the ultimate punishment for kids who keep coming back: Boys' School.

programme.title: D-Day: The Untold Stories
programme.desc: Presenta los acontecimientos clave de la invasión aliada de la Europa controlada por los nazis durante la 2GM y honra los diversos orígenes de todos los que sirvieron, incluidas las experiencias de afroamericanos, asiáticoamericanos, latinos y mujeres.

programme.title: D-Days In The Pacific: The Final Graveyard
programme.desc: The word D-Day, the military speak designation for a start of an amphibious attack, has become synonymous with the Normandy Invasion. But in reality, there were more than a dozen D-Days in the Pacific, many on the scale of Normandy, and one, Okinawa, even larger. In this three hour special, World War II specialists Lou Reda Productions will examine the sometimes disastrous, sometimes brilliant D-Days of the Pacific.

programme.title: License to Pawn
programme.desc: "Pawn Stars" follows three generations of the Harrison family as they assess the value of items coming in and out of their Gold & Silver Pawn Shop in Las Vegas, from the commonplace to the truly historic.

programme.title: American Hero
programme.desc: Rick Dale, one of Pawn Stars' most popular experts, runs Las Vegas based Rick's Restorations, a family business that finds, restores and upcycles cool objects ranging from Cadillacs to Coke Machines. The before and after reveals of his work are always highlights, in part because of the history nuggets Rick Dale shares about each object, whether it's a barber chair or a gas pump. In this spinoff series, featuring the dynamic characters at Rick's workplace, viewers will watch a variety of objects be bought, bartered and transformed, learning the process of restoration -- how do you duplicate Coke machine red? Where can you find 1920's tires? A storyteller who works with tools instead of a pen, Rick shares when and why objects were invented, who used them and how fixing or transforming them changes their value.

programme.title: Trashy Situation
programme.desc: With a record number of Americans trading city life for homes in the suburbs, relationships between neighbors are being put to the test. Each half-hour episode of "Neighborhood Wars" takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

Each half-hour episode of "Neighborhood Wars" takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

programme.title: Fighting the Tow
programme.desc: Roadways can be a wild place. With violent road rage incidents increasing 500% over the last decade, 'road raging' is a human behavior that has become widely known. The bad driving phenomenon hasn't helped either-- in fact it's said that 80% of all accidents are caused by 20% of drivers. "Road Wars" takes a deep dive into American roadways, examining extreme human behavior, wild weather, insane accidents and a few welcomed instances of acts of kindness.

programme.title: Drama At The Drive Through
programme.desc: With supply chain shortages, prices skyrocketing and?more shoplifting than ever before, positive customer relations are nearly impossible.?A&E?s new series CUSTOMER WARS?spotlights the conflicts that arise when disgruntled and irrational customers come face to face with the employees doing their best to take care of their needs. programme.title: Neighbors Know No Boundaries
programme.desc: With a record number of Americans trading city life for homes in the suburbs, relationships between neighbors are being put to the test. Each half-hour episode of "Neighborhood Wars" takes viewers into the homes and backyards of neighbors across the country with some of the most unexpected and emotionally charged events caught on camera. Featuring footage from cell phones, drones, home security cameras and more, the series showcases the kindness and conflict between real-life neighbors throughout the US.

programme.title: The Moment of Truth...
programme.desc: Unconventional couples on their way to the altar face staunch criticism from loved ones who refuse to give their blessing and set aside personal prejudices about differences_x000D_ in race, religion, class, or sexuality. With wedding plans well in the works, couples, and their futures are on the line. Which couples love will be enough to outweigh the opposition? Which will crack under the pressure? Whose family and friends will show up? And of those that do, will they voice their disapproval or forever hold their_x000D_ peace?

programme.title: Switch Therapy
programme.desc: Seven years marks a defining point in many relationships when couples find themselves restless, dissatisfied, and_x000D_ curious about what life would be like with someone else. Seven Year Switch? lets them find out. For two whole weeks, couples swap partners to see what life is like living with a complete stranger who seems to have all the qualities these individuals think they are missing in their current relationships. Will this ultimate experiment in "switch therapy" provide new appreciation for the love they have or entice them to call it quits?

programme.title: Out of the Comfort Zone and Into the Sea
programme.desc: In the Big City, true love is increasingly hard to achieve. But what if brave souls, yearning for romance and a loving partnership, agree to a provocative proposal: getting married at first sight? This groundbreaking format offers a shockingly novel twist on the relationship, dating and wedding space. Four experts - a therapist, anthropologist, spiritualist and clinical psychologist - will create what they believe are three perfect couples. The twist is that these couples will never meet or know each other until they walk down the aisle and see each other face to face - for the first time - at the altar. Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

Each self-contained episode will track classic lifestyle stories of newlyweds: the honeymoon; early nesting; meeting the in-laws; and other universally relatable events of married life. Will they remain together in the end, or decide to separate?

programme.title: She Never Came Home
programme.desc: However shocking the crime, media headlines eventually fade, but for heartbroken friends and family, the memories and their longing for justice never do. Cold Case Files? produced by the team behind Investigative ReportsTM, digs deep into the past, following detectives as they strive to breathe new life into "cold" unsolved crimes. Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

Armed with the latest DNA technology and with dogged determination, investigators seek new leads in hopes of bringing the guilty to justice decades after the crimes have been committed. Whether it's a man who was initially a prime suspect in his son's death, watching as the police begin to suspect his wife or the gruesome shooting of an elderly couple whose bodies were found in the woods, each episode features a different cold case.

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber
programme.desc: Jesse Cole, the visionary owner of the Savannah Bananas, turned a failing college summer baseball team into a $500 million entertainment empire by doing the exact opposite of what everyone else did. Suzy Kolber traces how a man in a yellow tuxedo built a global phenomenon by asking a question nobody else was: What if the fans and true fun are the whole point? Jesse opens up about being nearly $2 million in debt and the critics who were certain he was out of his mind - right up until he wasn't.

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber
programme.desc: Few people love anything more than Jon Gruden loves football. programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Kukro
programme.desc: A young hunter Ubadu lived in his 'Deadland', Kukro. Nothing he did in that land succeeded. One day, while he was hunting, he had an encounter with the gods which turned his life around. However, he broke the laws of the gods and he was going to die for his sin. He then pleaded that the gods spare his life and make his descendants pay for his sins. Many hundred years have gone by and from each of the generations that came after him, the gods picked one person to bear the mark of the curse.

programme.title: Wheel and Deal
programme.desc: Addicted to the desire for this pleasurable life leads a retired Marine Corps to plot a scheme along with a computer genius on how to get rich regardless of those involved. A one million dollars life insurance policy is his initiative and his children;Georgia, Kelvin and Regina are his beneficiaries including his grandchildren (Ben Jr & Benita). To receive the money once he’s dead, he carries on his first plan. He and his felon partner who happens to be a genius in hijacking, infiltrate the health system, pose as the personal to Kels by creating a terminal disease that Kels (this Ex-Marie Corps) suffers from.

programme.title: Demon Inside
programme.desc: Raped and scarred by her gynaecologist, Dr. Kyle. Evi seeks justice and vengeance on this rapist on the prowl that may go Scot free like other abusers. But with Kyle's license revoked and sent to prison, all is not fair until the DEMON INSIDE surfaces.

programme.title: Turning Tables
programme.desc: OSAHON OSUNIDE, a successful divorce attorney finds himself in a forbidden affair with one of his clients DIANE JACOBS who is going through a bad divorce However, Diane’s old school sweetheart finds his way back into her life. This throws Osahon’s world upside down as he begins obsessing over Diane which leads to a series of unfortunate events

programme.title: Rishai
programme.desc: Nyakio finds herself consumed by depression and overwhelming guilt following the tragic drowning of her son. Her despair reaches a breaking point, leading her to contemplate taking her own life. With a noose around her neck as she is about to surrender to the darkness, Jay, a tough debt collector working for a local loan shark, storms into her home. Nyakio owes money and he’s come to collect. Fate brings these two disparate souls together, forcing them to share an unexpected weekend. As they reluctantly share this time, Nyakio gradually realizes that Jay carries his own profound emotional wounds, which bear a surprising resemblance to her own. Through their shared experiences and unforeseen misadventures, Nyakio and Jay unwittingly heal each other along the way and get within the grasp of finding hope and a will to live.

programme.title: Leaking Womb
programme.desc: LEAKING WOMB a story of Yaya and Pete[a brother and a sister] who lost their child Hilda into a barren society that is in dire need of a child after being cursed by their father who termed their relationship as a taboo.The curse was to make them not to completely remember anything for two years.They are chased out of their homestead .A Sterile man[Mavuli] picks the child[Hilda] by the road and sells her to a couple[Kasisi and Velma] who are in need of a child too.Yaya and Pete become street children who are later helped by a good samaritan Mzee Tela.Mzee Tela passes on sending Yaya and Pete back to the streets of Nakuru.Kasisi employees Yaya as a houseboy to take care of the child as he helps his sister in the streets.The child goes missing in his hands.Kasisi tells Yaya to find the child and bring her back or else he stands losing his life.Yaya and Pete brings the child back but she is taken again in the presence of Kasisi for failing to clear the balance he had for the child.Yaya struggles to bring his sister to live with them.Kasisi chases Velma .He rapes Pete and marries her to get another child.Yaya and Pete plots ways to kill Kasisi for killing Mzee Tela and mistreating them.its later understood that Kasisi is Pete's father when a woman [her mother] who was mistreating her in the streets come begging for a job.

programme.title: Kapana
programme.desc: George, insurance broker, openly gay in a country where sodomy is still a crime, meets Simeon in a bar. The following day, they accidently meet again at Simeon's work place. Simeon is a Kapana seller (kapana is the local name for barbecued meet). George realises Simeon is in the closet. They keep seeing each other at the market. George then discovers that Simeon also plays soccer and is in the same team as his brother. They start meeting regularly. Simeon even accidentally meets George's family. Everything seems to go well, until Simeon realises George is on ARV. He feels betrayed George has never shared his status before and they break up. While Simeon drinks and tries one night stand with other guys, George gets depressed. Windhoek being a small city, they eventually meet again. In the end Simeon's sister, a nurse, help him understand that he can be with someone who is HIV positive and takes his ARV. Simeon goes back to George, apologising for his behaviour.

programme.title: Mono
programme.desc: "Young students arrive at the prestigious Francis Morris Morton Mission High School (Framomo) to join Form One. Their parents believe that this is the right school to turn their sons into men. As the boys discover a deep and sinister rot in the school, they try to fight for their voice, but it could cost them more than they are willing to sacrifice. Will Oliver and his friends survive Framomo?"

programme.title: Ndoto Za Elibidi
programme.desc: NDOTO ZA ELIBIDI was devised originally as a stage play for actors from the Nairobi slums. The story pivots around the theme of acceptance and love as its colorful protagonists – parents, four daughters and their lovers – come to terms with HIV and ghetto life. Cutting back and forth from fiction to documentary, from the original stage play to the actual locations, it takes us on two parallel journeys: we watch the story, but we are also watching it through the eyes of the ghetto audience.

programme.title: Dear Bayo
programme.desc: The film is a love story between a youth corper Bayo and a girl he meets Ebipade. Both from humble backgrounds are smitten by each other but to have to overcome difficulties in their personal lives to be together.

programme.title: Siyabonga (We Are Thankful)
programme.desc: Siyabonga (english title: We Are Thankful), named after the films main character Siyabonga Majola, is a docufiction film set in the KwaZulu Natal region of modern day South Africa. It makes use of footage from both the narrative and documentary tradition. In the film we follow Siyabonga, a young man making theatre plays in the township of Mphopomeni. One day he hears the surprising news that a movie is to be made in a nearby town and he makes it his mission to be part of the film. From conspiring with a maid to steal wifi from the umlungus (white people) so he can write an email to the film producers, to rebuffing a friend’s urgent plea for him to improve his luck through witchcraft, Siyabonga's journey takes him down many surprising paths that ultimately lead him to meeting with the film's director. Here we observe the conversation that caused the film we are watching to come into existence. A film based on real events, re-enacted by those who lived through them, we follow this extraordinary man as he does all he can to try and improve his life and take control of his fortune. Siyabonga's past echoes in his present in much the same way that South Africa's own history seems to have left an indelible mark on the people and places of the film. Time moves differently in such spaces. Places are never confined to just the here and now, but rather some kind of eternal memory.

programme.title: Dalitso
programme.desc: Mercy, a girl aged 13 and raped by her step father rejects her pregnancy with the help of her mother through an illegal abortion. The child dumped in a pit latrine survives and finds a home at an orphanage center.

programme.title: Silver Lining
programme.desc: Young, professional, and successful, Zoe and Boyd, a medical doctor, desperately want to have a baby. She is in her third pregnancy, and the family is doing everything possible to see Zoe successfully deliver, but she has a third miscarriage, while being hesitant to tell the family. Lubanji, Zoe's old best friend who is fleeing for stealing money from her ruthless fiancé, seeks Boyd's assistance in delivering the baby she is carrying so that she can sell it to some old woman, but Zoe instead begs Boyd to buy the child from her when it is born while she pretends to be pregnant. Everything appears to be fine until Lubanji is abducted by her fiancé on the day of her delivery.

programme.title: Ayaanle
programme.desc: AYAANLE is a 21 year old, young man living in Nairobi who aspires to become an actor and reach Hollywood. Despite his conservative upbringing and coming from an impoverished background, he remains optimistic about making it in the film industry and hopes to emulate his hero Denzel Washington. His life is turned upside down after a series of unlikely events that led him to becoming the most wanted man in Kenya and in connection with terror activities across East Africa. The nightmare starts with a corrupt police squad arresting him without due cause. His sister has to use the entire family savings to bail him out of jail leaving the family facing hard times. In his desperation to recoup the funds, Ayaanle is coerced by a friend to join a hoax that he is orchestrating in order to make some quick money. A news crew from the global news network GNN are in Nairobi to film a story about the activities of terror networks in East Africa. The real terror group are unwilling to provide interviews so a friend and Ayaanle conspire to hoodwink the news crew and pretend to be members of the terror group for the purposes of the interview in order to extract some money from the news team. Unfortunately for Ayaanle, the two crooked policemen who arrested him earlier also end up viewing the news item and recognizing him straight away. The cops end up frantically searching for Ayaanle and his team all over Eastleigh Nairob; they want to get to him first before anyone else does. Unfortunately for Ayaanle, this is where his life begins to unravel as he is soon at the mercy of the crooked policemen, an anti-terror unit and other underhanded characters. Left with no options, he is forced to defy all the odds in an attempt to save his life.

programme.title: The Silent Intruder
programme.desc: Catherine seeks help from Zaki, a charismatic but troubled sex therapist, to address her marriage's intimacy issues. As she becomes ensnared in his seductive but dangerous world, she soon realizes Zaki's allure masks a dark, compulsive nature. Her attempt to escape not only exposes Zaki's psychopathy but also ignites his obsession, transforming her effort to salvage her marriage into a desperate struggle to survive his increasingly menacing advances. The story encapsulates the peril of mistaking manipulation for affection and the resilience needed to break free from a predator's clutches.

programme.title: Songs About My Mother
programme.desc: The story explores how this toxic dynamic has profoundly shaped the protagonist’s artistic voice, influencing both the themes and emotional intensity of her music. As past wounds resurface and unresolved tensions escalate, the film examines the fragile boundaries between creative inspiration and personal trauma.

programme.title: Sungura
programme.desc: Kemunto is struggling to fit in at a friend’s bridal shower when Mama Asali, a traditional sexologist or Senga arrives and draws her into the fun. But it quickly becomes clear that Mama Asali's routine is not designed for Kemunto who uses a wheelchair making her frustrated and increasingly withdrawn. The assumption by the other women that having a disability means she can't have sex, makes her feel worse. Then the Senga brings out her colourful collection of dildos and vibrators, and Kemunto becomes obsessed with Sungura (rabbit). She must however navigate this crowded party to get Mama Asali alone in order to buy one; or find the courage to buy it in front of the other women, who believe she shouldn't need a vibrator in the first place.

programme.title: Mulasi (My Friends)
programme.desc: “Mulasi” follows a group of female childhood friends Sechelela, Zamoyoni, Ginger and Jamila, who also happen to be jobless yet qualified lawyers. They all decide to bow out and find a way to survive in a demanding society in order to pay their bills. During their journey, they navigate challenges in their relationships, social lives and marriages.

programme.title: A Hotel Called Memory
programme.desc: The narrative tells the story of Lola, recently separated from her husband in Lagos, and who will then try a fresh start in Zanzibar in the hope of forgetting the past and moving on with her life.

programme.title: Zero
programme.desc: Alone on her bed, Bénédicte, a thirty-year-old woman, listens religiously to the tube ZERO by Papa Wemba - dead, recently on the FEMUA festival scene in Abidjan. In this candle-lit room, her eyes moisten with tears as her thoughts go into her fourteen years spent in the mythical group of the deceased (VIVA LA MUSICA) before focusing on her fears and on its financial situation. A few days later, Bénédicte, who is known as a dancer, goes to a television station where she talks about her experience alongside the one whom the journalist calls "THE SCHOOLS MASTER " and affectionately calls him "PAPA" (DAD) Before announcing his plan to remix his tube ZERO. For completing her perilous project, whose aim is both to pay tribute to her former boss and launch her career as a singer, Bénédicte was accompanied by Moli - a renowned vocal coach and Tosha - a masterpiece of VIVA LA MUSICA orchestra.

programme.title: Jaja
programme.desc: JAJA is a representation of how people objectify women. sometimes even the women also forget their worth. The problem being within the community which is rigid to change. When a woman speaks up, the community will point fingers at her. Abuse her, calling her all sought of names that will make her appear less of a woman. And yet when a woman decides to keep quiet to avoid criticism, the first assumption is that she is either dumb, stupid or weak. The worst part of it all is when the woman comes from a poor background, she lacks ambition due what people ignore most, fear. She is afraid of believing in herself, she is afraid of achieving more because she may ‘lack a spouse” as the local community dictates, she is afraid that once she succeeds people will not see the effort rather than be blamed for seduction. When in reality most men are not only taking advantage of girls but also working women.The film Jaja brings all these aspects into life. It pushes the motion of women emancipation. We see the protagonist who has been abducted by sex traffickers, her journey throughout the film with the traffickers, and how the authority reacts towards it.We need to free the community from these ideologies that prevent it from progress and make women understand that they dominate their own future, they are phenomenal.

programme.title: Marriage Beyond Love
programme.desc: In a college, Clay Lwazi, the only son of an Awol Priest Steven Lwazi) is in love with Miriam, daughter of Mr. Leozora-a well-known wealthy man. As their love grows, Rebecca comes across scheming to be in love with Clay as well. Rebecca is unaware of her status of being HIV positive since she was raped earlier on by the bandits who had held them hostage in their own house and killed her father Dominic Bouziz -who was involved in shady deals. Clay so resisting, Rebecca has to multiply her strategies. On the right occasion of her birthday she invites Clay to the party. In the ambience of the party, Clay is drunk and Rebecca takes advantage and spends the night with him. Early in the morning he wakes up in a totally different place only to find himself half naked with Rebecca. Later on, Miriam stands to marry Clay, before they get married they go for an HIV test and surprisingly Clay is HIV positive. With this result Miriam’s parents stand against their marriage. Therefore, Mira finds herself stuck between a rock and a hard place with the decision to choose between her family and the love of her life. The matter becomes worse as Miriam is contesting against the family's decision, thereupon the Parents get to scheme on how to stop the relationship. Very confused and heart sick, Miriam goes missing and the matter is reported to the police. The news is spread all over the city, coincidentally Clay and Miriam meet in the bush and the scenario is used by Mariam’s parents as an obstacle on how to get Clay jailed and stop the relationship. Clay is brought to court with a false allegation driven by them in order to end their relationship. The Judgment is made and Clay is found innocent. The Judge hands the ball to Miriam to decide whether she wants to marry Clay or not, but she chooses to marry him. With the prayers they receive from the man of God, the marriage takes place and miraculously Clay is now HIV negative. Both families become aware of what happened and they all come together to reconcile.

programme.title: Mirage
programme.desc: While serving a 5-year sentence at one of Zimbabwe's tightest prisons just outside of Harare, Tambu learns of the abuse of her daughter by her own brother back home. Fuelled by the passionate anger of a single mother, Tambu convinces fellow inmates Memo and Zoe to escape together with her. The plan hangs on a thin thread, as rumours of the escape surface, fuelling an ongoing power struggle between one of the officers and the prison warden. Tambu seizes the moment during a prison ceremony by a popular pastor, and on the backdrop of the Zimbabwean coup in 2017, where president Robert Mugabe was ousted. The trio embark on a thrilling and dangerous prison break. As we follow the 3 young women's journey to freedom, we ask ourselves: How do you escape yourself?

programme.title: Kan Kan

Despite international fame, health issues related to alcoholism, growing tensions within his troupe, and financial difficulties seriously threaten the future of his career. His only hope lies in organizing a show in the town of Nkongsamba. Will he overcome his demons and reclaim his success?

programme.title: Kienyeji

Amid exams, financial struggles, and personal setbacks, their journey unfolds with Ohangla and Mugithi music, raising questions about love and tradition. Will love triumph, or will societal pressures prevail?

programme.desc: Ghanaian schoolteacher Akosua, planning to move to the U.S. with her new boyfriend Adrian, faces resistance from her students upon revealing her departure and doubts about Adrian's fidelity. programme.title: When Love Happens Again
programme.desc: When an event planner leaves her boyfriend behind for Los Angeles, their relationship is put to the test. Partnered with a billionaire business mogul, she finds herself further from home than ever before. Will love overcome distance?

programme.title: Maria Khristu - The Buumba Story
programme.desc: Buumba, a 16-year-old aspiring writer and devout follower of the Maria Kristu church, struggles with the traditional belief that a woman's place is beside her husband. Conflicted between her dreams and the church doctrine, she questions her role and attempts to break free, facing societal and religious challenges. In her pursuit of freedom, she confronts the harsh reality that true independence demands personal sacrifice and determination.

programme.title: Ghost Story

programme.title: Dau

programme.title: Scama O'Rama

Their plan works until a friend reveals their plot to the authorities.

programme.title: First Born
programme.desc: A grade six boy Langcer Divine (Frubi Rollins) is caught in a web of abuse and neglect by his school teachers and peers because of his dullness. He is refused to be registered as an internal candidate for the Common Entrance Examination, as the school wishes to uphold its reputation of academic excellence. Back at home, Divine being the lone child to his parents, goes through emotional torture as they scold at him at every given opportunity. In the midst of his pain and dark clouds, his class teacher Mr. Pangala Nicodemus (Tampy Livinus) comes to his rescue by unraveling a biblical revelation 'Exodus 13:2'. It is discovered that Divine as a first born to his parents, inherited a curse. Could this have been the cause of his dullness or was he a victim of stigmatization and hate by a school system that cares for bright pupils and its reputation to the detriment of slow learners?

programme.title: Tom, Dick & Harrie Episode 1
programme.desc: "Tom, Dick, and Harrie" is a hilarious web series that unfolds the comedic tale of two roommates - Tom and Dick - facing the financial strain of rent. To alleviate their burden, they decide to find a third roommate through a social media ad. Enter Harrie, a mysterious new tenant who happens to be Dick's ex-girlfriend, Harriet. Harriet seizes the opportunity to re-enter Dick's life in an unconventional way; disguising herself as a guy named Harrie and secretly paying for a room in their apartment. When Dick discovers the ruse, he proposes a temporary truce, agreeing to cohabitate for a month until Harrie can find alternative accommodation. What ensues is a rollercoaster of comedic episodes as the once lovebirds navigate the challenges of living together again. Will the close quarters and shared experiences rekindle their old flame, or will it lead to more chaos and hilarity? Join Tom, Dick, and the disguised Harrie as they embark on a month-long journey that unravels into unexpected twists and turns. Discover whether this unusual living arrangement sparks a new chapter in their relationships and buckle up for a laughter-filled ride in "Tom, Dick, and Harrie."

programme.title: The Coffin Salesman
programme.desc: Uwem is a small town business man who has hit hard times as he has not made sales because he lives in a town where everyone is exercising, quitting smoking and generally trying to live healthier lifestyles. This isn’t good for his business as sales are seriously reduced. His problems are compounded when his wife leaves him and he is left with their daughter Nse who is suspended from school for refusing to take off her superhero costume. Uwem has to also contend with the aggressive takeover of his new neighbor HD Yaw who owns KPAI Assassination Limited and covets his small business. Everything comes to a head when he meets Ogun Lesley who is dying and has a list of odd things he wants to do before he goes…and this becomes Uwem’s most important coffin sale

programme.title: Daughters of Donald
programme.desc: Chief Donald is living the later years of his life in lonesome luxury and perfect celibacy. But the peace and quiet in his big mansion are shattered when one young lady, and then another, suddenly show up claiming to be his daughters from past relationships he had completely forgotten about. And it will not stop there: everyone is now a suspect as ghosts from Chief Donald’s adventurous past come to haunt him in the form of children, he never knew he had, including some who have been living and working right under his nose, unbeknownst to him. The cultural conflicts and heartbreaking drama resulting from this late discovery of self, and the trauma imposed by DNA tests and struggles for belonging, are only subdued by the hilarious natures of the comic characters who bring the whole story to life. The movie is set in Asaba (Nollywood), Nigeria, featuring actors from Cameroon and Nigeria. Generous use of African Music provided by BGC Melody from Cameroon, Congo DRC, Ghana and Nigeria. Executive Production by Don Julio Bats for BGC Melody Story

programme.title: Wayunagu
programme.desc: A former Kickboxer from the United States named Ivan, returns to his native land of Honduras. Viewed as a foreigner by the locals, Ivan has a hard time fitting in. After a botched robbery and accidental murder of a teenager, Ivan finds himself being hunted by a group of machete wielding bandits intent on revenge. Lost, injured and alone, Ivan must discover himself in the jungles of Honduras and face his fears, in order to save his own life...

programme.title: Obambo
programme.desc: Present day March 15 2021, it is night Zabron arrives at the haunted house that is believed to have Obambo ghost. Short while Tama arrives as well. Zabron draw a knife ready to fight the ghost Obambo but Tama stops him. Tama tells Zabron that he must know the history first before fighting Obambo because it is believed that is the most powerful ghost than any ghost that Zabron has fought before. 2003, it is night, Zunda and his family; his wife Mona, younger sister Anna and younger brother Leonard are getting things in the house that is believed to have Obambo ghost. Zunda tells Leonard to hurry up because he has a lot to do tomorrow at his work. The family members are at dinner table eating. Suddenly Obambo hand take Leonard food. Leonard panics and drop the spoon. Other members look at him surprisingly. Leonard get the spoon under the table and sees Obambo’s feet. Leonard panics again and asks everyone if they have seen it to which everyone is surprised. Zunda tells Leonard to go to his room and take his foolishness there. Leonard tells his brother that they are not alone in the house and leaves. Anna laughs at Leonard. On the way to the his room, Leonard heard unsettling noises and see red flashes and smoke coming from one of the room. He stops turn around and investigate the matter before a door open in the other direction. Leonard turns and he can see a person resembles his brother stand beside the door. Leonard calls him but no answer. His brother Zunda comes and asks him who is talking to and Leonard says that he saw his brother standing on the door. Zunda tells Leonard not to stand near the room where noises are heard as the house owner asks Zunda not to open that room. Zunda gets angry and tell him to go to his room and sleep. His wife Mona and asks him why they should not open the room, Zunda replies that the house owner asked him to do that as there are his belongings there. It is mid night. Anna gets to bed. Obambo is seen in the shadow getting near her bed and put something on the flowers. Her bedsheet is pulled off. She gets up worried and take the bedsheet and cover her up. After few seconds the bedsheet is pulled again and she wakes and sit on the bed. Anna starts to look up and sees Obambo in the ceiling. She screams. The family members hears the scream and get in Anna’s room quickly. She is terrified.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S07 E08
programme.desc: In order to bypass sacred Shoshone burial grounds, Cheyenne scouts land for the railroad. Cheyenne's deal doesn't satisfy the railroad foreman and others. They try to eliminate him by any means possible, including using a Chinese girl to poison him.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E30
programme.desc: A troubled 18-year-old named Johnny Clover ransacks the North Fork Schoolhouse, stealing art supplies. Lucas later tries to help Johnny, but he lives with a controlling uncle who proves to be difficult to deal with.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E31
programme.desc: A neighboring rancher's son is seriously injured in an accident. With the young man's condition getting worse, Lucas learns the rancher won't take his son to the doctor since he feels his wife died from poor treatment.

programme.title: F Troop - S02 E16
programme.desc: A new saloon owner named Dan Lawson takes over O'Rourke and Agarn's business. He quickly raises prices and adds a cover charge, angering the regular patrons. Lawson adds new entertainment with dancing can-can girls creating quite the spectacle.

programme.title: F Troop - S02 E17
programme.desc: Two renegade Indians known as the Loco Brothers kidnap Captain Wilton Parmenter from Fort Courage and hold him captive in a cave. It seems all they want is someone to talk to and be friends with. Later, the renegades join the friendly Hekawi Tribe.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E04
programme.desc: After a devastating storm, ranch foreman George McJunkin finds ancient bison fossils and flint points unearthed in a riverbank, and he sets out to find someone in the scientific community who will acknowledge the importance of his discovery.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E05
programme.desc: Throughout Deadwood, Calamity Jane is known as a hot-tempered drunk. But when a deadly smallpox outbreak spreads through town, Calamity Jane works tirelessly to save the lives of the infected citizens who once treated her with such contempt.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E05
programme.desc: A young Jedediah Smith joins William Ashley's expedition and helps establish the fur trade along the Missouri River, but it's not hunting or trapping he longs for...it's adventure. Inspired by Lewis and Clark, he wants to explore the vast, uncharted American frontier. Trekking through unknown and unforgiving terrain, Smith's iron will and unwavering courage under fire help him survive a vicious grizzly bear attack, hostile Native Americans, and life-or-death periods of starvation, dehydration, and exhaustion. During his incredible journeys, he becomes the first non-Native American to cross the Mojave Desert into California, the first to navigate through the perilous Sierra Nevada Mountains, and the first to traverse the Great Basin Desert. He ultimately sees more of the American West than any other adventurer, including Lewis and Clark, and opens the frontier in a way that no other mountain man can claim.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - S05 E06
programme.desc: A storm is coming to The Cowboy Way! Cody visits his cousin Bo to secure steer for his upcoming rodeo, leaving Booger and Bubba to ear-tag some yearlings by themselves. Bubba takes the opportunity to put houseguest Andrew to work. Misty continues to try and shake off her barrel-racing rust, and comes to a serious crossroads with her misbehaving mare. Jaclyn presses Booger to put a timeline on finding them a permanent home. Bubba sets out on a solo trip back to Texas to check out a lead on a big herd of Tigerstripe cattle. But just when he's about to cross the state line, a devastating category 4 hurricane barrels down on Alabama. All the cowboys' best-laid plans come to a screeching halt. Bubba must decide whether to turn around and head home, or push through for the big deal. Finding themselves directly in the path of the hurricane, everyone scrambles to prepare their ranches for the worst. Can the cowboys and their families safely ride out the storm?

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E16
programme.desc: Bret Maverick searches for buried Confederate treasure worth $500,000 in Elwood, Kansas. However, he is constantly harassed by Marshal Mort Dooley, who runs him out of town. Bret, in turn, outwits the marshal, setting up a showdown between the two.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S05 E04
programme.desc: Cheyenne helps an Apache woman escape torture from her tribe. He transports her to Santa Fe. However, angry Apaches retaliate and attack a settlement. The pair also encounters gold-hungry prospectors along the way.

programme.desc: Cheyenne is guiding a buffalo hunting party that Marshal Lestrade is leading. Lestrade's daughter Lily and Senator Carr are in the group. Cheyenne finds a herd, but a mysterious gunshot sends the buffalo on a stampede. Cheyenne is suspicious.

programme.desc: A Chinese man named Wang Chi and his son, Wang Lee, come to North Fork to open a laundry service in town. Vince Fergus, a prejudiced man, bullies them but Micah, Lucas, and Milly try to convince them to stay. A fight between Fergus and Lucas ensues.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S04 E01

programme.desc: After arriving in Medicine Bow, Wyoming, Bret Maverick is framed for both the murder of the mayor and for cheating the townsfolk. When an imposter uses his name, Bret relies on the scheming Melanie Blake and a superstitious lawyer to clear his name.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S07 E09
programme.desc: Appointed to fill an empty seat in the senate, Cheyenne starts a campaign to preserve the American bison after a tragic buffalo stampede. He soon discovers that politics is really not his strong suit and should return as a gunfighter.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E32
programme.desc: The residents force Miss Adams, the North Fork schoolteacher, to leave her job because they feel she is too progressive for supporting women's right to vote. Lucas gets involved and he learns that lies have been circulated by a past student.

programme.title: The Rifleman - S01 E33
programme.desc: Lucas has a disdain for Oat Jackford since years ago he burned down his ranch to get him off property he wanted. When hired killer Tom King arrives in North Fork and is on Oat's trail, Lucas decides to side with and help the man he once hated.

programme.title: F Troop - S02 E18
programme.desc: A beautiful, young Japanese woman named Miko seeks refuge at Fort Courage, escaping from an arranged marriage. A samurai pursues her to bring her back to Japan. The F Troop faces the samurai's wrath as he will stop at nothing in his pursuit.

programme.title: F Troop - S02 E19
programme.desc: A ten-year-old runaway named Joey Walker shows up at Fort Courage determined to enlist with the F Troop. O'Rourke tries to discourage the young boy by showing him that life there isn't glamorous. Meanwhile, tensions rise when Joey's mother arrives.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E06
programme.desc: After two Mexican vaqueros cross the border in search of their stolen cattle, they are gunned down by the rustlers. When El Paso's newly appointed marshal arrests local ranch hands for the murders, he sparks one of the West's most infamous gunfights.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E07
programme.desc: When gold goes missing from a safe in a remote mining town, Wells Fargo sends detectives Henry Johnson and Isaiah Lees to hunt down the culprits. Though the two men couldn't be more different, they must learn to work together to crack the case.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E06
programme.desc: Although from humble beginnings, Tom Fitzpatrick is ambitious and intelligent. When he joins up with William Ashley's trapping expedition, he proves himself to be an invaluable member of the company, both as a hardy frontiersman and a shrewd businessman. Along with legendary mountain man Jedediah Smith, Fitzpatrick rediscovers the South Pass through the Rocky Mountains, opening the pathway that will enable western expansion for decades to come. Fitzpatrick quickly rises to the top of the fur trade and eventually takes over the company he once worked for, but he nearly loses everything when he takes a wrong turn while leading a supply train. Alone in the wilderness, he finds himself in a deadly game of cat-and-mouse with a band of Gros Ventre warriors. Somehow, Fitzpatrick must survive the harrowing trek back to safety without a horse, gun, or supplies.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - S05 E07
programme.desc: Cody's rodeo is fast approaching and time is running out, so the cowboys head out to scout talent for the team-roping event. Misty's new barrel-racing horse has taken her training to a whole new level. So when Booger starts teasing her, she challenges him to a one-on-one race: cowboy vs barrel racer! Misty also comes up with a potential rodeo venue, so Cody heads out to Bay Minette, AL to lock down a site. Bubba and Kaley prepare for houseguest Andrew's family to arrive. Will Andrew finally find his own place, and get out of Kaley's hair? Meanwhile, the guys' reputation as cattle brokers starts to flourish. Booger gets a lead on a healthy herd of cattle in Texas, and the guys consider if they should go all-in and buy the entire herd. Booger heads back to the Lone Star State and strikes a deal that seems to be a win-win. But just as the guys get the ball rolling with another big deal, a phone call from their buyer puts everything in jeopardy.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E17
programme.desc: Bret and Bart Maverick race to be the first to cash a $10,000 bank draft after learning the exchange company has gone bankrupt. A woman tells them the Deadwood office hasn't yet learned the news. They dash to the office before an official can.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S05 E06
programme.desc: Cheyenne comes to town to be in Johnny McIntyre's wedding. Johnny and Lafe, his bride's brother, are celebrating. As Cheyenne arrives, Lafe shoots at him, thinking he's wanted. Tragedy occurs when Johnny accidentally shoots and kills Lafe.

programme.desc: Cheyenne, Bronco Layne, and Tom Sugarfoot Brewster battle an illegal gun trader dealing with Indians. Cheyenne's boss, Ian Stewart, puts a down payment on a tract of land that the gun trader uses. Trouble ensues.

programme.desc: After failing to capture the ruthless murderer Augustine Chacon on U.S. soil, Arizona Ranger Burton Mossman relinquishes his badge to cross the border. In Mexico, he goes undercover as a horse thief to join Chacon's gang and spring his trap.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - S03 E09
programme.desc: When a bloodthirsty mob storms a jailhouse holding a man accused of attempted murder, they are confronted by a 22-year-old missionary from the Sisters of Charity. Only Sister Blandina can stop the vigilantes from taking the law into their own hands.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - S01 E07
programme.desc: When former slave Jim Beckwourth heads west to seek work as a trapper, he begins what will become one of the most eventful, heroic lives of all the mountain men. As a joke, one of Beckwourth's fellow trappers tells a group of Crow warriors that Beckwourth is a long-lost member of their tribe, and the adventure begins. Adopted by the Crow, Beckwourth joins them in a series of ferocious battles with other tribes, becomes a war chief, and falls in love with a fierce female warrior named Pine Leaf. He then uses his hard-won influence with the Crow to convince them to provide furs to the powerful American Fur Company. But an unexpected visit from legendary trapper and old friend Tom Fitzpatrick sets off a violent collision that forces Beckwourth to choose between the two worlds he loves.

programme.title: The Cowboy Way - S05 E08
programme.desc: The cowboys step a little outside of their comfort zones. Looking to offload their new herd, the guys head down to the local stockyard to hone their bartering skills. Cody bounces a crazy rodeo idea off the boys - then uses them guinea pigs. Bubba plans a short getaway with Kaley, but there's a big catch: Booger's been tapped as the babysitter, with Jaclyn lending a helping hand. Kaley wonders if Booger is up to the challenge. His first attempts to feed and dress little Andie suggest he most certainly is not! While Bubba and Kaley aren't sure they'll return home to find everything in one piece, they do get some great news from houseguest Andrew. Cody is desperate to find the final missing piece for his rodeo: an announcer. While Booger adamant that he's the perfect man for the job, Cody has to resort to using reverse psychology on his old friend to avoid disaster.

programme.title: Maverick - S02 E18
programme.desc: Jack Vandergelt III is a millionaire set on courting a woman who despises rich men. Bret Maverick agrees to switch identities with Vandergelt so he can be loved as a humble man, but his father arrives to complicate matters.

programme.desc: During an arrest, Cheyenne shoots and kills the lawless son of Nathanael Grimm, a wealthy man who controls the town. Cheyenne faces a murder charge, and the townspeople are out of work when Grimm closes his mine in revenge.

programme.title: Cheyenne - S05 E09

programme.desc: Han pasado 3 años desde que María de Todos los Ángeles se ahogó en el fondo del tinaco y Doña Lucha quiere canonizar el burro de planchar donde supuestamente María dejó impresa la imagen de San Hipoclorito Arcángel.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Hazlo con ella
programme.desc: Gracias a una película, Albertano descubre una manera poco inusual de sacar a María del coma. Albertano con la ayuda de Betzabé trata de poner en marcha su plan, pero es interrumpido por Doña Lucha y Carmelo.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Coma pozole
programme.desc: María ha despertado del coma y para recibirla en la vecindad, Doña Lucha se ve forzada a hacer una comida de bienvenida. Durante la reunión, Glenda aparece para obligar a Albertano a quedarse con ella.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Tiempo de amigos
programme.desc: María trata de recuperar su vida después de haber estado en coma y decide formalizar su relación con Albertano, pero él solo quiere que sea su amiga. Doña Lucha se preocupa porque cree que el Macaco es mala influencia para el Chino.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Casino en la azotea
programme.desc: Reina Altagracia, la mamá de María, regresa para reencontrarse con su hija, pero ella no la acepta. Doña Lucha decide organizar una tarde de juegos con sus hijos, pero todo se complica cuando Reina comienza a apostar las cosas de María.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - La novia de Ludoviquito
programme.desc: Ludoviquito lleva a su novia a casa para presentarle a su familia, pero después terminan y su familia cree que se quiere suicidar.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Brad Pittin
programme.desc: Federica se reencuentra con su ex novio de la prepa, Nazario, alias Brad Pittin. Al ver que es un hombre rico y exitoso, Federica decide pasar más tiempo con él.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Video estúpido
programme.desc: Ludoviquito quiere entrar a un concurso de los videos más estúpidos de la gente y sin querer se lleva un video comprometedor de sus papás.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - El concurso de reclamos
programme.desc: Ludovico insiste en que su cuñada Lucrecia entre al concurso de reclamos que Federica ganó el año anterior, pero Don Camerino lo obliga a que Federica participe de nuevo.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Celosa, patética y desconfiada
programme.desc: Federica asiste a un seminario en un convento para controlar sus celos. Don Camerino le pide a Ludovico que lleve a su sobrina Leonarda al convento porque tiene problemas de alcohol.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Regalo de aniversario
programme.desc: Ludovico tiene que conseguir un regalo de aniversario para Federica antes de la cena para no dormir a oscuras en una tina.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Dulces recuerdos
programme.desc: Con mucho espíritu navideño, Federica y Ludovico presentan algunos bloopers que pasan durante las grabaciones.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Federica desaparece
programme.desc: Un mago desparece a Federica y la manda al desierto, donde los árabes la tratan como esclava. Ludovico está muy feliz por su libertad, aunque comienza a provocar problemas en la casa.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - Y el ganador es...
programme.desc: Mientras festejan el final del reality, el autobús deja a los héroes tirados en la carretera. Pasan la noche con una familia que lleva 40 años de muertos.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 17
programme.desc: Asustados por la inseguridad y temiendo perder su fortuna, Vítor y Albertano deciden comprar un rancho e irse a vivir al campo, pero los peligros de la ciudad no son nada comparados con el terror de enfrentarse al temible Charro sin Cabeza.

programme.title: Los Héroes del Norte - ¡Sálvese quien pueda!
programme.desc: Doña Olegaria encuentra un citatorio que pone a Los Héroes en riesgo, por esto tienen que cambiar su imagen y escaparse de la ciudad lo antes posible.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 18
programme.desc: Albertano adopta a Wilbur, el pony que conoció en el rancho, pero una de sus vecinas se opone a que viva en el edificio. Vítor y Albertano se las ingenian organizar una campaña para convencer a los vecino de que Wilbur se quede en el edificio.

programme.title: Nosotros Los Guapos Capítulo 19
programme.desc: Dolida porque Don Nacho olvidó su aniversario, Doña Cuca inicia un romance con su ex novio, el carnicero. Vítor y Albertano ayudan a Don Nacho a recuperar el amor de Doña Cuca.

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - La familia pequeña vive mejor
programme.desc: Una nueva norma del edificio dicta que cada departamento deberá tener un máximo de cinco miembros por familia, ¿qué hará la familia López?

programme.title: Una Familia de Diez - El nombre de la brosa
programme.desc: Victoria tiene que escribir el nombre de todos los miembros de su familia, ¿sabrá cuál es el verdadero nombre de la nena?

programme.title: Una familia de diez - Que bonita familia
programme.desc: Plácido tiene un mal día y se preocupa mucho cuando Plutarco le confiesa que se casó con la hija de su jefe porque está embarazada.

programme.title: Una familia de diez - Nuevos huéspedes
programme.desc: Plácido se preocupa porque Plutarco se robó a Gaby y podría perder su trabajo. Don Justo amenaza a Plácido con denunciar a Plutarco si Gaby no regresa a su casa en menos de 24 horas.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Sexy calendario
programme.desc: Doña Lucha tiene la idea de hacer un calendario con las abuelitas de la vecindad para ganar dinero. María se somete a una reparación estética para reconquistar a Albertano.

programme.title: María de Todos Los Ángeles - Se busca
programme.desc: El Chino consigue trabajo probando videojuegos y provoca que Albertano busque el empleo de sus sueños. María asiste a una cita a ciegas acompañada de Betzabé y las cosas no salen como ella espera.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - Bibi maneja
programme.desc: Ludovico le enseña a manejar a Bibi. Federica quiere deshacerse de Maradonio. Bibi choca el carro de Ludovico y la meten en la cárcel.

programme.title: La Familia P. Luche - El funeral del Merengues
programme.desc: Ludovico es obligado a asistir al funreal del Merengues, un viejo amigo de Industrias Camerino, pero se da cuenta que el muerto tiene su reloj y hará lo imposible por recuperarlo.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Alushe standupero
programme.desc: Alushe, el amigo de Paco, lo visita, pero Paco no contaba con que se quedaría más tiempo por algunos problemas que tiene porque perdió el trabajo. Ve de qué forma ayudará Paco a Alushe para que consiga un lugar en donde vivir y mejore su vida.

programme.title: 40 y 20 - Bienvenido, Fran
programme.desc: Después de 6 meses en Nueva York, Fran regresa a casa, pero todos notan un gran cambio en él y quieren saber si sus sospechas son ciertas. Paco le organiza una fiesta de bienvenida e invita a una mujer muy guapa, ¿qué pasará con Fran?

programme.title: Vecinos - Otro robo
programme.desc: Luis pierde dinero y cree que los vecinos se lo robaron.

programme.desc: Pedro y Benito quieren que alguien de los vecinos reemplace a Germán como portero en su equipo, Germán cree que le quieren quitar su trabajo.
